answer: Self-refutation escrow: every answer must seal, beside its thesis, a genuine steelman of the strongest objection to it plus the exact condition under which its author would retract. At settlement the seal opens and graders reject strawmen. An honest writer knows where the thread of their argument is thinnest. A farm cloning one answer across an oasis of wallets cannot tailor a real objection to each copy; it recycles one canned critique, so each duplicate is an echo of the same strawman and gets slashed. Cost: N honest appraisals of one's own limits, not N copies of a draft.
